scope.title: Tilt-aware geometry-only Bianchi type similarity and identifiability atlas
scope.tilt_definition: Dimensionless matter 3-velocity v relative to the normal congruence n^a of homogeneous slices; not an observer peculiar velocity.

conventions.structure_constants: C^k_ij = a_i delta^k_j - a_j delta^k_i + epsilon_ijm n^mk
conventions.frame_quotient: proper SO(3); parity-reflected configurations remain distinct in pseudoscalar tilt invariants

algebra_fingerprint.interpretation: complete for the restricted orthonormal metric Lie-algebra orbit under SO(3) and common positive scaling; not a general local-isometry classifier

curvature_fingerprint.interpretation: rotation-invariant curvature screening; not a complete local-isometry invariant for general homogeneous metrics

exact_degeneracies.result: Ric=0 for both; flat intrinsic geometry but different simply-transitive Bianchi group labels
Ric=-2 a^2 I for both; constant negative sectional curvature K=-a^2; h=a^2/p^2>0

tilt_orbit.moment_rank: number of distinct eigenvalues of Nhat
tilt_orbit.discrete_orientation: Class-A chi_A and Class-B q0/q1 preserve remaining SO(3) orientation information
tilt_orbit.degeneracy: Repeated eigenspaces retain a continuous azimuth only when v projects into that eigenspace; moment condition number grows as eigenvalues coalesce.
tilt_orbit.fail_closed: Do not use a pseudoinverse to emit a unique tilt vector when the moment matrix is rank deficient.

code_contract.inputs: BASS canonical BianchiAlgebra.a, .n, .C; finite v with |v|<1
validation: structure_tensor_from_an enforces symmetric n and Jacobi n@a=0
spatial_ricci_from_structure_tensor verifies the full bracket Jacobi identity
recover_tilt_squared_components enforces valid (a,n) Jacobi data and 0 <= speed_squared < 1

acceptance.prior_standalone_oracle: 35 PASS in isolated canonical fixture package

claim_firewall: No claim that all 11 tilted states solve Einstein-fluid constraints
No identification of global fluid tilt with observer boost
No CMB transfer, polarization, Cl or Bayesian evidence claims
Curvature-only similarity is not sufficient to identify the Bianchi group action

prior_art.work: Ferrando & Saez 2020, Homogeneous three-dimensional Riemannian spaces
prior_art.implication: intrinsic algorithmic classification of homogeneous 3D Riemannian spaces using Ricci structure and derivatives; structure tensor decomposed through N and a
applies intrinsic classification to spatially homogeneous cosmologies

prior_art.work: Jakub 2026, A Clifford-algebraic framework for Bianchi cosmologies
prior_art.implication: high overlap in coordinate-free N,q Jacobi classification, curvature and tilted-fluid framework; author preprint, not peer-reviewed, full text restricted

literature_review.orientation_note: SO(3) quotient is explicitly oriented. Do not claim physical parity-odd invariants until the O(3) pseudotensor transformation of n and all tilt pseudoscalars is derived.
literature_review.novelty_boundary: reproducible BASS geometry-only diagnostics, rank-stratified normal-frame tilt identifiability and regression no-go examples; not a new Bianchi classification or coordinate-free formalism
